description: Split a list of people into fair random teams: choose the number of teams or people per team. Add a skill level ("Ali, 5" / "Sara: 3") and teams are balanced by total skill (people without one count as the average). Team names: numbers, letters, colours, animals or your own. Crypto-random shuffle; optional seed for a reproducible split. Max 2000 people, 100 teams. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/team-maker/

balance.description: Balance teams by skill when skills are given.

customNames.description: naming=custom: team names in order (missing ones fall back to "Team N").

naming.description: Team names: Team 1…, Team A…, colours, animals, or customNames.

num.description: Number of teams (min 2) or people per team (min 1), see mode.

people.description: People, one per item, optionally "Name, skill" (skill 0–100).

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible result (same seed + same input = same output). Omit for true crypto randomness.

text.description: Or: people as text, one per line.

name: random_teams
title: Team maker
